registration_detail: Add "aiAssistantCredits.spec.js" to the GeneralTests entry's run_files array in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (the OSS matrix), and mirror it in the enterprise/cloud overlay matrices if they list GeneralTests shards separately.
rationale: No existing Playwright E2E covers the AI Assistant credits notice or paid-usage consent. changed_files.txt contains only Vitest unit specs (web/src/**/*.spec.ts) and no tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js; existing_tests_in_diff is false. The AI assistant is a global, cross-cutting chat surface (header toggle -> O2AIChat), so GeneralTests (not Logs/Metrics/Alerts) is the correct folder. The feature is cloud/enterprise-gated and its trigger states (exhausted/low credits, 402/412) are backend-set, so tests must stub the APIs via page.route — the same pattern already used in 32 existing specs (e.g. Onboarding/billing.spec.js).
